LESSON: SOURCE DOCUMENTS AND BOOKS OF ORIGINAL ENTRY

Grade: Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Financial Records in Business
Topic 4.3: Source Documents and Books of Original Entry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Source Documents and Books of Original Entry, part of Financial Records in Business in Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: What are the source documents used in book keeping? 2. Why are the books of original entry important in book keeping?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  discuss and present on the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book keeping,  search and present using available resources the information on types of source documents for recording business transactions,  brainstorm and presents on the types of books of original entry,  record business transactions in relevant books of original entry. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  discuss and present on the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book keeping,  search and present using available resources the information on types of source documents for recording business transactions,  brainstorm and presents on the types of books of original entry,  record business transactions in relevant books of original entry. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Source Documents and Books of Original Entry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy: The learner develops effective communication skills when discussing and presenting on the meaning and

importance of source documents and books of original entry in book keeping.

 Critical thinking and Problem solving: The learner acquires evaluation and decision-making skills when recording business

transactions in relevant books of original entry.

37

Values:
 Love: The learner respects others when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of source documents and

books of original entry in book keeping.

 Respect: The learner shows regard for the contributions of every member of the team when discussing and presenting on the

meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book keeping.

 Responsibility: The learner shows determination when recording business transactions in relevant books of original entry.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Financial literacy: Bookkeeping skills of the learner are enhanced when recording business transactions in relevant books of

original entry.

 Peer education and Mentorship: The learner enhances inter-personal relationships when discussing and presenting on the

meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book keeping.

 Internet safety and Security: Responsible online behaviour is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to search for

information on the types of source documents for recording business transactions.

 Mental health: Emotional awareness is enhanced as the learner brainstorms and present on the types of books of original

entry.

38
